data.one_liner: Gherkin parser and test runner for Dart and Flutter behavior-driven development.
data.what_it_does: A Gherkin parser and test runner that lets developers write behavior-driven development (BDD) feature files and test scenarios for Flutter applications. It integrates with Flutter Driver to automate user interactions and check states across various devices.
use_when: You want to practice Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) using Gherkin syntax in Flutter
You need to run feature files and scenarios against a running Flutter application via Flutter Driver
avoid_when: You prefer standard unit and widget testing without BDD syntax
You require packages that rely on reflection for step definitions
strengths: Full Gherkin syntax and Cucumber-like test runner support
Built-in step definitions and helper utilities for Flutter Driver
Supports custom step parameters, hooks, and multiple reporting formats
weaknesses: Does not use reflection, so custom classes like steps, hooks, and reporters must be explicitly registered
Requires manual configuration and test driver setup
data.setup_notes: Requires creating a test_driver file to enable the Flutter driver extension, configuring feature files, and manually wiring step definitions.
